import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Data cleaning and preparation
df.drop_duplicates(inplace=True)
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder', inplace=True)
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set up the visualization style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9))

# Create the scatter plot
# This plot shows the relationship between sleep duration and quality,
# while encoding other key health metrics.
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Stress Level',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    style='Sleep Disorder',
    palette='viridis_r',
    sizes=(100, 500),
    ax=ax,
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.8,
    s=200 # base size for legend
)

# Improve aesthetics and add information
ax.set_title('Comprehensive Health Profile vs. Sleep Quality', fontsize=20, pad=20, weight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14, labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=14, labelpad=10)

# Add annotations for each point to provide context
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax.text(
        row['Sleep Duration'] + 0.02,
        row['Quality of Sleep'],
        f"{row['Occupation']}\nHR: {row['Heart Rate']} bpm",
        fontsize=10,
        ha='left',
        va='center',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", fc="white", ec="gray", lw=1, alpha=0.7)
    )

# Adjust legend
h, l = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate legends for better clarity
legend1 = plt.legend(h[1:5], l[1:5], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', title='Stress Level', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')
ax.add_artist(legend1)
legend2 = plt.legend(h[5:8], l[5:8], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.7), loc='upper left', title='Physical Activity', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')
ax.add_artist(legend2)
legend3 = plt.legend(h[8:], l[8:], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.45), loc='upper left', title='Sleep Disorder', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11')

# Final adjustments
plt.xlim(5.8, 6.3)
plt.ylim(3.5, 6.5)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1]) # Adjust layout to make space for legends

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
